# Morph

Flows one image into the next along a displacement field: the old image is pushed away as it fades while the new one settles into place. The field is noise, or a displacement map of your own.

<EffectDemo effect="morph" />

## Usage

```ts
import { createTransition, toHoloEffect } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { morph } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/morph';

const effect = morph({ preset: 'liquid' });

// Standalone: blend two textures as progress goes from 0 to 1.
const player = createTransition(renderer, effect, {
  from: textureA,
  to: textureB,
});
player.progress = 0.5;
player.render();

// With HoloCSS: hand it to transition3d().
import { transition3d } from '@mk7s/holocss/three';
await transition3d(fromElement, toElement, toHoloEffect(effect), {
  target,
  update,
});
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.strength = 0.15`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter  | Type       | Default | Range     | Description                                                                                               |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `strength` | number     | `0.15`  | 0 – 1     | How far the images are pushed, as a fraction of the frame.                                                |
| `scale`    | number     | `2`     | 0.25 – 16 | Noise field: size of the swirls (higher is finer).                                                        |
| `map`      | 2D texture | `null`  |           | A displacement map: red and green, centered on mid-gray, give the direction. Replaces the noise when set. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                      |
| -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `liquid` | `strength: 0.3`, `scale: 1.2` |
| `ripple` | `strength: 0.06`, `scale: 6`  |
| `subtle` | `strength: 0.05`              |

Apply one with `morph({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Transitions · tracked as story X13.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** transition. `createTransition(renderer, effect, { from, to })` runs it on two textures; `toHoloEffect(effect)` turns it into a HoloCSS `ThreeEffect` (parameters are baked in when called), with the `hcss-fold` CSS fallback. See [transitions](/guide/transitions).
- **Motion:** driven by `progress` from your timeline. HoloCSS skips transitions when motion is off; standalone, set `progress = 1` instead of animating.
- **Size:** 7.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/morph`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Opposed displacement of both images along a noise or map field, crossfaded.

## Related

- [Crossfade & luma wipe](./crossfade) — Blends to the next image everywhere at once, through noise, or along a luma pattern (linear, radial, diamond or spiral) with a soft edge that can glow in the theme accent.
- [Liquid flow warp](./flow-warp) — Swirls the image through a slowly changing flow field (curl noise), so it moves like ink in water without tearing.
- [Zoom / warp speed](./zoom-transition) — Rushes into the image with radial speed streaks from a center, then the next image arrives out of the same streaks and settles to its size.
